title: Yasmine Bassil earns her PhD
text: Dr. Bassil defended her dissertation on how the brain's navigation network changes with age, and is now an Assistant Research Scientist in the lab.

title: Catie Mason receives an NIH F31 fellowship
Oindrila Sinha named a McCallum Early Career Fellow
text: The fellowship, from the Jack and Dana McCallum Neurorehabilitation Program, supports her work on how eye movements reveal motor learning.

title: Five new members join the lab
text: Rekha Crawford joins as a Neuroscience PhD student, Joon Han Kim as an affiliated research specialist, and Grace Kim, Kaili Tseng, and Yash Varakala as undergraduate researchers.

title: Jasmine Mirdamadi starts as Assistant Professor at the University of Vermont
text: Dr. Mirdamadi, a former research scientist in the lab, now leads her own research group and continues to collaborate with us.

title: Neuroscience 2026, the Society for Neuroscience annual meeting
text: The largest yearly gathering of neuroscientists, with talks and posters on the latest brain research.
where: Walter E. Washington Convention Center, Washington, D.C.
